name: close-confirmation
whatItDemonstrates: A tweet-composer drawer whose close attempts (backdrop click, Esc, close button, or swipe) are intercepted to show a controlled confirmation AlertDialog when the textarea has unsaved text.
stateManaged: controlled — useState for drawer open, confirmation-dialog open, and textarea value; onOpenChange calls eventDetails.cancel() to block the close while text exists and opens the confirmation instead
nonTrivialInteractions: onOpenChange receives (open, eventDetails); when closing with non-empty textarea it calls eventDetails.cancel() and setConfirmationOpen(true), so every dismissal surface (backdrop, Esc/CloseWatcher, Drawer.Close, swipe) funnels into the confirmation
closing without text resets the textarea value before committing the close via setDrawerOpen(open)
form submit preventDefaults, clears the textarea, and closes the drawer; Cancel is a Drawer.Close inside the form
Discard button in the AlertDialog closes the dialog, clears the textarea, and sets drawerOpen false in one handler
popup shows a dimming after-overlay while confirmationOpen is true (conditional class), and the title is linked to the textarea via aria-labelledby with a React.useId

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A right-side drawer that slides in from the edge and can be swiped (mouse or touch) to dismiss, with all state left to the component.
nonTrivialInteractions: swipe-to-dismiss on a right drawer: popup transform composes var(--drawer-swipe-movement-x); data-swiping selects text off and zeroes transition
backdrop opacity scales with var(--drawer-swipe-progress) and its ending-style duration scales with var(--drawer-swipe-strength); data-swiping zeroes backdrop transition
open/close transitions via data-starting-style/data-ending-style transforms (translateX off-screen past a bleed allowance) on a 450ms cubic-bezier

viewport padding plus negative popup margin create a desktop bleed effect, disabled on iOS Safari via supports-[-webkit-touch-callout:none] variants; data-ending-style translates to calc(100% - bleed + padding + 2px)

name: indent-provider
whatItDemonstrates: A bottom sheet inside a Drawer.Provider whose Indent surface shrinks, rounds, and reacts to swipe progress while the drawer is open, with the drawer portal scoped into that same box.
stateManaged: uncontrolled drawer; useState<HTMLDivElement | null> holds the portal container element passed to Drawer.Portal container
nonTrivialInteractions: Drawer.Provider + IndentBackground + Indent form the indent tree: IndentBackground paints behind and the Indent box receives [data-active] while any drawer is open
Indent styling derives --indent-radius and --indent-transition from var(--drawer-swipe-progress), scaling to 0.98 and translating 0.5rem on data-active with progress-driven interpolation
Drawer.Portal container={portalContainer} renders the backdrop/viewport inside the relative container instead of document.body; backdrop is absolute, not fixed
non-modal Root so the indent surface stays interactive; bottom-sheet popup uses translateY(var(--drawer-swipe-movement-y)) with safe-area-inset-bottom padding

name: mobile-nav
whatItDemonstrates: A full-screen mobile navigation sheet built from Drawer parts over a ScrollArea long link list, dismissed by flicking down from the top.
nonTrivialInteractions: ScrollArea.Root is placed inside Drawer.Viewport with style={{ position: undefined }} so the drawer viewport, not the scroll root, provides positioning; drawer swipe translate happens on the Popup while scrolling lives in the ScrollArea.Viewport

coordinated open/close animation: ScrollArea.Root and Popup both translate via group-data-starting-style (translate-y-100dvh) and data-ending-style, with the Viewport marked group so popup/scroll-area respond to drawer state
default swipeDirection (down for a bottom sheet) gives flick-to-dismiss from the top; description text instructs it
icon-only Drawer.Close uses aria-label="Close menu" over an inline XIcon svg component
backdrop uses a custom gradient with --backdrop-opacity 1 (0.7 dark) and distinct 600ms/350ms open/close timings; nav panel shadow fades on group-data-ending-style

name: nested
whatItDemonstrates: Three independently focus-managed drawers stacked via nested Drawer.Roots, styled with a constant peek so each parent scales down and lifts behind the frontmost one.
nonTrivialInteractions: child Drawer.Root/Trigger/Portal trees are nested inside the parent's Popup content; only the outermost level renders a Backdrop

shared popup class derives stack depth from var(--nested-drawers) (--stack-step 0.05 peek/scale), interpolates with clamp()-ed var(--drawer-swipe-progress), and positions via translateY combining --drawer-swipe-movement-y, the computed peek offset, and shrink height
variable-height stacking: height from var(--drawer-height) with fallback, and --drawer-frontmost-height minus bleed driving data-nested-drawer-open h/overflow clipping

parent content (handle + content) fades out on group-data-nested-drawer-open and back in on group-data-nested-drawer-swiping via opacity transitions; popup shows a black/5 after-overlay when data-nested-drawer-open
frontmost (Advanced) drawer is intentionally taller (input, textarea) to exercise --drawer-height/--drawer-frontmost-height alignment; inputs use defaultValue only

name: non-modal
whatItDemonstrates: A non-modal right drawer that does not trap focus, ignores outside clicks, and only closes via its close button or a swipe.
nonTrivialInteractions: modal={false} opts out of focus trapping; disablePointerDismissal keeps the drawer open on outside clicks; no Backdrop is rendered at all
Viewport gets pointer-events-none and the Popup pointer-events-auto so the underlying page stays interactive while the drawer is open
swipe-to-dismiss on the right via var(--drawer-swipe-movement-x) with starting/ending-style translateX; box-shadow (not backdrop opacity) animates on open/close to signal modality difference
data-ending-style duration scales with var(--drawer-swipe-strength); iOS bleed variants mirror the hero drawer

name: position
whatItDemonstrates: A plain bottom-anchored notifications sheet relying on default drawer behavior (default swipeDirection), positioned entirely by styles.
nonTrivialInteractions: bottom position is achieved by the Viewport's items-end justify-center flex layout; no positioning props are used

default swipe-to-dismiss direction for a bottom sheet; popup transform composes translateY(var(--drawer-swipe-movement-y)) with starting/ending-style translateY(calc(100% - 3rem + 2px)) matching the popup's -mb-[3rem] bleed
popup bottom padding reserves env(safe-area-inset-bottom) plus bleed; max-h 80vh with overflow-y-auto and data-swiping text-selection lock
backdrop fades with --drawer-swipe-progress and release timing scales with --drawer-swipe-strength as in the hero

name: snap-points
whatItDemonstrates: A bottom sheet with two snap points — a compact peek and a near full-height view — where dragging snaps between them and the offset is applied in styles.
stateManaged: uncontrolled drawer; snapPoints is a module-level constant (['31rem', 1] — a 30rem visible height plus 1rem top margin, and the fraction 1 for full viewport height); no React state
nonTrivialInteractions: popup transform is translateY(calc(var(--drawer-snap-point-offset) + var(--drawer-swipe-movement-y))) and padding-bottom mirrors the same calc so content stays within the snapped frame
Popup style prop injects the --top-margin CSS variable used to derive the string snap point; snap points mix a '31rem' string and the 1 fraction
static drag header (handle + title) sits outside the scrollable Drawer.Content, which is the only touch-auto/overscroll-contain scroll region; popup and header are touch-none
viewport renders a fixed after-element covering the bleed area below the sheet, hidden on data-closed; starting/ending-style reset transform and padding-bottom for entry/exit animation

name: swipe-area
whatItDemonstrates: An edge strip (Drawer.SwipeArea) that opens a non-modal right drawer via a swipe gesture, with no trigger button anywhere.
stateManaged: uncontrolled drawer; useState<HTMLDivElement | null> holds the portal container element passed to Drawer.Portal container
nonTrivialInteractions: Drawer.SwipeArea is a 10-wide strip along the right edge (inset-y-0 right-0) whose footprint is the only way to open the drawer; it contains a pointer-events-none rotated 'Swipe here' label
modal={false} keeps the demo container interactive while open; swipeDirection="right" matches the right-edge placement
Drawer.Portal container={portalContainer} scopes the backdrop/viewport to the bordered demo box (backdrop and viewport absolute, viewport z-20 above the SwipeArea)
same right-drawer swipe mechanics as the hero: --drawer-swipe-movement-x transform, starting/ending-style translateX, swipe-progress backdrop fade

name: uncontained
whatItDemonstrates: An action sheet whose popup is an invisible container holding two visually separate surfaces — a grouped action list plus a detached destructive 'Block User' card.
stateManaged: controlled — useState(false) passed as open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}; every action button and the Block User button call setOpen(false) directly
nonTrivialInteractions: the Popup itself is pointer-events-none and purely a positioning/gesture shell; each visual card (Drawer.Content surface and the danger surface sibling) opts back in with pointer-events-auto, creating a gap between surfaces
Title, Description, and one Drawer.Close (inside the first action li) are rendered visually hidden (sr-only) so the sheet stays accessible while the actions are plain buttons
the separate destructive 'Block User' button lives outside Drawer.Content (a Popup child) and closes the sheet via the controlled state, not via Drawer.Close
swipe-to-dismiss on the bottom via --drawer-swipe-movement-y with 1rem gap accounted for in starting/ending-style translateY(calc(100% + 1rem + 2px)); no shadow transition on the shell

name: virtual-keyboard-aware
whatItDemonstrates: A near full-height form sheet wrapped in Drawer.VirtualKeyboardProvider so its scrollable inputs and a pinned footer input stay usable when the software keyboard opens.
stateManaged: none — fully uncontrolled; all inputs are uncontrolled DOM fields
nonTrivialInteractions: Drawer.VirtualKeyboardProvider wraps the Portal (inside Root) with zero props, activating keyboard-aware alignment for the form fields

footer slot reserves min-height var(--footer-reserved-height) and grows by var(--drawer-keyboard-inset, 0px) on focus-within; the footer bar switches to position: fixed (inside the popup's transform) on focus-within and adds the same inset to its bottom padding
always-0px fallback var(--drawer-keyboard-inset, 0px) is used in both footer computations; 260ms transitions on min-height/bottom/padding-bottom with motion-reduce opt-outs

header (handle, Cancel and Save Drawer.Close buttons, Title) and footer are outside the scrollable Drawer.Content — the only overflow-y-auto region; popup/header touch-none with touch-auto content keeps swipes working over the form
swipe-to-dismiss via --drawer-swipe-movement-y with a -mb bleed under the popup; data-swiping text-selection lock; viewport after-element covers the bleed area (hidden while swiping or closed)
